caption: The drawing depicts a single elongated metallic object, positioned vertically in the center of a plain light beige background. The object is rusty brown in color and appears weathered, displaying textured surface details. It has a narrow, slightly tapering form with rounded ends. The top end features a circular hole, and the lower end has a rolled cylindrical segment also with a hole. Running along the length of the object are five evenly spaced circular holes. The shadowing and highlights suggest a metallic material. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a signature that reads "Herman Ulrich 1939."
title: Strap Hinge for Door
